 ET Online | 23 Oct 2026, 11:12 PM IST Russian President Vladimir Putin, during a recent interview, has intensified geopolitical debate as he proclaimed that 'it is impossible to defeat Russia'. Referring to the Russia-Ukraine war, Putin stated that thinking of defeating Moscow is 'unrealistic'. Stirring controversy over Ukraine's territorial losses, he called the regions historically Russian. Putin also shared his thoughts on a conceivable trilateral negotiation concerning the ongoing war.
